title: Don't Miss a Thing With 'Eagle Eyes'
credits: Anna Matteo wrote this story for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: And now, Words and Their Stories, from VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们来听“词汇与故事”，来自美国之音英语学习。

sentences.en: From above, birds must have a wonderful view of the world below.
sentences.zh: 从高空俯瞰，鸟儿一定对下方的世界有着美妙的视野。

sentences.en: Flying over everything at such a height gives them a rare ability to see many things.
sentences.zh: 以如此高的高度飞越一切，赋予了它们一种罕见的能力，能够看到许多事物。

sentences.en: In English, we use the term “bird’s eye view” to describe a view from above as if seen by a bird in flight.
sentences.zh: 在英语中，我们用“鸟瞰”这个词来描述从上方看到的景象，仿佛是由一只飞翔中的鸟儿所看到的。

sentences.en: It is also described as an “overall view” or “big picture view.”
sentences.zh: 它也被描述为“整体视角”或“大局观”。

sentences.en: For example, when I start a project, I first like to get a bird’s eye view.
sentences.zh: 例如，当我开始一个项目时，我首先喜欢获得一个鸟瞰的视角。

sentences.en: I ask myself several important questions: What is the overall goal?
sentences.zh: 我问自己几个重要的问题：总目标是什么？

sentences.en: Who is the main focus?
sentences.zh: 主要关注点是谁？

sentences.en: What resources do I have available to me?
sentences.zh: 我有哪些可用的资源？

sentences.en: Answers to these “big picture” questions can help me understand the scope of the project.
sentences.zh: 对这些“大局”问题的答案能帮助我理解项目的范围。

sentences.en: Now, let's talk about noticing the smaller details.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们来谈谈注意更小的细节。

sentences.en: Some birds, called raptors, are known for their extremely sharp vision.
sentences.zh: 一些被称为猛禽的鸟儿，以其极其锐利的视力而闻名。

sentences.en: Eagles, hawks, and owls can see their prey from very far away.
sentences.zh: 鹰、隼和猫头鹰能够从很远的地方看到它们的猎物。

sentences.en: The Raptor Center is part of the University of Minnesota’s College of Veterinary Medicine.
sentences.zh: 猛禽中心是明尼苏达大学兽医学院的一部分。

sentences.en: Its website explains why eagles, hawks, and owls see so well: “Raptors have powerful binocular vision, where both their left and right eyes can see and focus on a single object.”
sentences.zh: 其网站解释了为什么鹰、隼和猫头鹰看得如此清楚：“猛禽拥有强大的双眼视觉，它们的左眼和右眼都能看到并聚焦于单一物体。”

sentences.en: Eagles and hawks also have a special bone structure around their eyes that protects them from bright sunlight.
sentences.zh: 鹰和隼的眼睛周围还有一种特殊的骨骼结构，保护它们免受刺眼阳光的照射。

sentences.en: Their ability to focus on faraway details in addition to other factors make them extremely effective hunters.
sentences.zh: 除了其他因素外，它们聚焦遥远细节的能力使它们成为极其高效的猎手。

sentences.en: In English, the keen vision of eagles and hawks describes a certain type of person.
sentences.zh: 在英语中，鹰和隼锐利的视力用来描述某一特定类型的人。

sentences.en: If you have an eagle eye, you have the ability to see or notice distant objects.
sentences.zh: 如果你有一双鹰眼，你就有能力看到或注意到遥远的物体。

sentences.en: Also, you observe everything, even very small details which others might miss.
sentences.zh: 此外，你会观察到一切，甚至是别人可能会错过的小细节。

sentences.en: On the same note, someone who is hawk-eyed watches and notices everything that happens.
sentences.zh: 同样地，目光敏锐的人会观察到并注意到发生的一切。

sentences.en: These types of people may even perceive things that are not clear to others.
sentences.zh: 这类人甚至能察觉到别人看不清楚的东西。

sentences.en: Both eagle-eyed and hawk-eyed people are observant or perceptive.
sentences.zh: 无论是目光如鹰还是目光如隼的人，都善于观察或具有洞察力。

sentences.en: A person does not have to have this ability all the time.
sentences.zh: 一个人不必始终具备这种能力。

sentences.en: They might use their keen vision and powers of observation only at certain times, especially times when they need to keep a close watch.
sentences.zh: 他们或许只在特定时刻运用自己敏锐的视力和观察力，尤其是在需要密切监视的时候。

sentences.en: For example, during Christmastime, hawk-eyed children might search the sky looking for Santa Claus.
sentences.zh: 例如，在圣诞节期间，目光敏锐的孩子们可能会仰望天空，寻找圣诞老人。

sentences.en: These children may not be very observant during the rest of the year, but during Christmastime, they are looking for gifts.
sentences.zh: 这些孩子在全年其他时间可能并不善于观察，但在圣诞节期间，他们却在寻找礼物。

sentences.en: Let’s hear these terms used between two friends.
sentences.zh: 让我们听听这两个朋友如何使用这些说法。

sentences.en: A: This is a great party.
sentences.zh: A：这是个很棒的派对。

sentences.en: Thanks for inviting me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的邀请。

sentences.en: B: The more the merrier!
sentences.zh: B：人多更热闹嘛！

sentences.en: This yearly neighborhood party always draws a huge number of people.
sentences.zh: 这个每年一次的社区派对总是吸引大量人群。

sentences.en: A: I’d say so!
sentences.zh: A：我说是呢！

sentences.en: There must be over a hundred people here!
sentences.zh: 这里肯定有一百多人吧！

sentences.en: Hey, wait a minute.
sentences.zh: 嘿，等一下。

sentences.en: I think I see our old co-worker.
sentences.zh: 我想我看到了我们以前的同事。

sentences.en: Isn’t that Samantha way over there by the food and drinks?
sentences.zh: 那边食物和饮料旁边的那个人难道不是萨曼塔吗？

sentences.en: B: I don’t know.
sentences.zh: B：我不知道。

sentences.en: I can’t see that far.
sentences.zh: 我看不清那么远。

sentences.en: A: It’s her.
sentences.zh: A：就是她。

sentences.en: My eagle eyes don’t miss a thing.
sentences.zh: 我的鹰眼可什么都逃不过。

sentences.en: I’m going to go say hi and grab the last hamburger while I’m there.
sentences.zh: 我打算过去打个招呼，顺便拿最后一个汉堡。

sentences.en: Oh, and you should let the hosts know that they’re low on drinks.
sentences.zh: 对了，你应该告诉主人，他们的饮料快不够了。

sentences.en: B: Wow! You’re right.
sentences.zh: B：哇！你说得对。

sentences.en: I didn’t realize you were so hawk-eyed.
sentences.zh: 我没想到你这么眼尖。

sentences.en: A: Only at parties.
sentences.zh: A：只在聚会上才这样。

sentences.en: I start off with a bird’s eye view and then focus in on the food, drinks, and people I want to see more closely.
sentences.zh: 我先来个鸟瞰的全局视角，然后聚焦到我想要更仔细观察的食物、饮料和人。

sentences.en: See you in a few…
sentences.zh: 一会儿见……

sentences.en: The term “eagle eye” has been used for hundreds of years.
sentences.zh: “eagle eye”（鹰眼）这个词已经使用了数百年。

sentences.en: Word experts say it was first used in writing in the mid-1500s.
sentences.zh: 语言专家认为，它最早出现在书面语中是在1550年代中期。

sentences.en: The Oxford English Dictionary website says the “earliest evidence for ‘eagle eye’ is from 1567, in the writing of Thomas Stapleton, a Roman Catholic theologian.”
sentences.zh: 《牛津英语词典》网站称：“‘eagle eye’最早的例证出自1567年，罗马天主教神学家托马斯·斯塔普尔顿的著作。”

sentences.en: A theologian is an expert in religious thought.
sentences.zh: 神学家是宗教思想方面的专家。

sentences.en: And that’s all the time we have for this Words and Their Stories.
sentences.zh: 本期《词语及其故事》到这里就结束了。

sentences.en: Until next time, I’m Anna Matteo.
sentences.zh: 下次见，我是安娜·马泰奥。

glossary.def: things that can be seen from a certain position or place
the thing that takes up most of one’s attention : focus –v. to make an image seen by the eyes as sharp as possible
to see and pay attention to something
an animal that is being hunted
one thing that is involved in a process aimed at producing a result
